description: Rules enforced across the whole platform, whichever app asks. Each section is one rule.

fields.label: Invitations
fields.description: Who an invitation from any app may reach.

fields.label: Allowed invitation domains
fields.description: One domain per line, e.g. tatvacare.in. An invitation from any app (CRM, Desk, Insights) is sent only to an address on these domains. Blank sends to any address.

fields.label: Blocked invitation domains
fields.description: One domain per line, e.g. gmail.com. An invitation from any app (CRM, Desk, Insights) is never sent to an address on these domains, even one on the allowed list: Blocked always wins. Blank blocks none.

fields.label: App Documentation
fields.description: Where each app's Docs opens, in its menu on desktop and mobile. An app with no row shows no Docs.

name: Tatva Platform Settings
